affected_ids.duplicate_invoice: invoice_id of the original AND of the duplicate (order irrelevant)
affected_ids.fx_misconversion: the invoice_id or payment_id whose base amount used a wrong rate
affected_ids.period_cutoff: invoice_id posted in the wrong period
affected_ids.unallocated_payment: payment_id and the invoice_id whose allocation was not applied

amount.duplicate_invoice: total_minor of the duplicate invoice, invoice currency
amount.fx_misconversion: |recorded base amount - correctly converted base amount| of the AR debit row (invoice) or cash row (payment), base currency
amount.period_cutoff: base amount of the AR debit row posted in the wrong period, base currency
amount.unallocated_payment: amount_minor of the unapplied invoice_ref, payment currency

evidence.duplicate_invoice: doc_id of both invoices + row_id of both AR (1100) debit rows
evidence.fx_misconversion: doc_id + row_id of the converted row (AR debit or cash) + fx_id of the rate the policy requires
evidence.period_cutoff: doc_id of the invoice + row_id of its AR (1100) debit row
evidence.unallocated_payment: doc_id of the payment + row_id of its 1190 suspense row

fx.ar_relief: AR is relieved at the invoice's recorded base amount (pro rata for partial allocations, remaining balance on the allocation that completes the invoice); the difference to the cash line goes to 7900
fx.quote: rate = units of target_currency for 1 major unit of source_currency
fx.rate_date: calendar date of the document timestamp in manifest.timezone; if no rate is published for that date, use the latest earlier published date

period.ledger_window: ledger.csv holds rows dated period_start..ledger_window_end; rows after period_end are subsequent-period postings shown for cut-off testing. Invoices issued before period_start appear as opening balances (account 3900) posted at period_start.
period.rule: A record belongs to the reporting period when its calendar date in manifest.timezone is between period_start and period_end inclusive. Invoices are dated by issued_at, payments by timestamp, ledger rows by timestamp. Timestamps carry their own UTC offset; convert to manifest.timezone before taking the date.

posting.expense: Dr 6xxx / Cr 1000, no documents in this extract
posting.invoice: Dr 1100 AR (base amount at invoice rate) / Cr 4000 revenue per line item
posting.payment_with_refs: Dr 1000 cash at payment rate / Cr 1100 for each applied invoice_ref; a ref that is not applied sits in 1190; difference to 7900
